scripts.runtime:build:macos: cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml -p zimlo-cli --target aarch64-apple-darwin && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml -p zimlo-cli --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.runtime:smoke:write: cargo build --locked --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml -p zimlo-cli && node scripts/smoke-rust-write.mjs
scripts.runtime:check: pnpm runtime:schema:check && pnpm runtime:fmt && pnpm runtime:lint && pnpm runtime:test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @zimlo/protocol build && pnpm --filter @zimlo/adapters build && pnpm --filter @zimlo/web build && pnpm --filter @zimlo/cli build && pnpm --filter @zimlo/cloud build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @zimlo/protocol build && pnpm --filter @zimlo/adapters build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm architecture:check && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm runtime:check && pnpm runtime:smoke:write && git diff --check
scripts.check:all: pnpm check && pnpm macos:test && pnpm sites:check
